name: Multi Measure Trend
description: Several measures over time on one chart. Each measure can be a solid, dashed or dotted line, an area or bars, with its own color and axis, plus a tooltip comparing them.

name: Smart Table
description: Fast flat table for large data (virtual scrolling): sort and filter any column, search, conditional colors, totals, and row selection that drives dashboard actions.

name: Smooth Trend
description: Smooth line trend with a KPI header (latest, MTD, QTD, YTD or your own calculation), growth/degrowth coloring and smart tooltips.
